scenes.title: The Warm Syrup Under the Frosting
scenes.storyBeat: Warm syrup hides inside the chilled frosting flow.
storyboardPanels: Bloop melts into a tiny puddle shape.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Syrup velocity exceeds recommended festival sweetness.
Poor thing. You are not melting. You are being hurried.
Let me cool the edge. Not the heart.

choices.label: Cool the Frosting Flow
choices.playerLine: A calmer syrup makes a cleaner board.
choices.narration: Nixie cools the pipe seams without freezing them shut.

choices.label: Taste the Rainbow Melt
choices.playerLine: This syrup is carrying a flavor. I should know it before I silence it.
choices.narration: Nixie recognizes part of her rainbow gelato supply, warmed until it forgot its shape.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain freeze and sticky warning guard.

choices.label: Freeze the Sprinkle Tide
choices.playerLine: A bright freeze, quick and just dramatic enough.
choices.narration: The syrup becomes glittering candy glass. The floor sparkles and slides.

postChoiceBarks.text: Slow hands. Clear eyes. Let the board cool into place.

victoryCallback.text: The syrup remembers it is sweet, not frantic.

bossCallback.text: Your frosting is too warm, little king. Sit still. We will save the flavor.

scenes.title: Heat in the Helpful Machine
scenes.storyBeat: A machine needs cooling without being forced silent.
storyboardPanels: A gauge trembles at Completely Fine.
Toy bombs roll in polite circles.
Nixie traces frost along one gear tooth.

preChoiceDialogue.text: If the gauge is shaking, it is technically still attached.
That is not a rule. That is a confession with bolts.
It wants to help. Stopping it is simple, but not kind.

choices.label: Lower the Boiler Heat
choices.playerLine: Helpful machines should not steam like soup.
choices.narration: Nixie lowers the boiler heat and slows the worst junk bursts.

choices.label: Cool the Machine Without Stopping It
choices.playerLine: Little engine, keep your purpose. Lose only the fever.
choices.narration: The machine keeps helping, slowly enough to choose what help means.

choices.label: Skate the Conveyor Loop
choices.playerLine: If the belt insists on moving, I will make it graceful.

npcResponse.text: Not a standard safety category. Deeply interesting.

choices.narration: The belt becomes a glittering track. Pieces arrive faster, but clearer.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain extra preview with speed risk.

postChoiceBarks.text: Cool the belt, not the idea.

victoryCallback.text: The machine is still helpful, and no longer sweating screws.

bossCallback.text: Keep the assistance. Lower the panic.

scenes.title: The Names of Missing Flavors
scenes.storyBeat: Lost flavors ask to be named before they melt.
storyboardPanels: Gelato crates sit under blurred labels.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Flavor identity stored beneath layered ice.
They are still here. Just under too much winter.

choices.label: Stabilize the Gelato Shelves
choices.playerLine: Nothing can be recovered while the pantry is sliding.
choices.narration: Nixie braces the shelves with careful frost.

choices.label: Name Every Lost Flavor
choices.playerLine: Sprinkle Sunrise. Moonmint. Lanternberry. Come back slowly.
choices.narration: The labels sharpen one by one. The flavors answer as faint colors under frost.

choices.label: Crack the Crystal Scoops
choices.playerLine: A clean fracture, pretty enough to forgive.

npcResponse.text: Recovered flavor sparkles should report to the cart.

choices.narration: Crystal scoops burst into rare ingredients and tricky ice.

postChoiceBarks.text: A frozen block is not quiet. It is waiting.

victoryCallback.text: The pantry is breathing again. Coldly, but that is its preference.

bossCallback.text: Gelato Golem, the flavors have names. They do not need to shout in ice.

scenes.title: The Room That Breathes
scenes.storyBeat: The sleeping room teaches that quiet is alive.
storyboardPanels: Blankets rise and fall like breathing.
A draft curls around soft blocks.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Then we should not freeze its dream in place.

choices.label: Quiet the Blanket Draft
choices.playerLine: Cool the draft. Let the blankets choose the rest.
choices.narration: Nixie settles the blanket draft and softens Sleepy pressure.

choices.label: Hear the Sleeping Room
choices.playerLine: I will listen to the silence without making it still.
choices.narration: The room hums with safe rest, not absence. Nixie lets it stay alive.

choices.label: Slide Through the Sock-Ice
choices.playerLine: Small slides only. We are festive, not reckless.
choices.narration: Nixie turns the floor into a moonlit sock-ice path and glides through sleepy blocks.

bossCallback.text: Sir Snore-a-Lot, we will pass between snores, not through them.

scenes.title: The Score That Needed Time
scenes.storyBeat: The arcade score should slow down enough for everyone to understand it.

preChoiceDialogue.text: A score no one can read is not a score. It is weather.
No. We will let meaning catch up.

choices.label: Dim the Neon Frost
choices.playerLine: Dim the glare. Leave the game.
choices.narration: The display slows just enough for players to plan.

choices.label: Share the Slow Score
choices.playerLine: Everyone should see how the points arrive.
choices.narration: The cabinet displays each cascade long enough for the crowd to cheer the pattern.

choices.label: Spin the Prize Chill
choices.playerLine: One clean spin, then we let it settle.
choices.narration: The wheel spins in glittering frost, pays out, and nearly speeds away.

postChoiceBarks.text: A slow score is still a victory.

victoryCallback.text: The arcade understands itself a little better.

bossCallback.text: Hydra, slow enough for everyone to see is still bright enough.

scenes.title: The Corner Under Frost
scenes.storyBeat: Bloxley's hidden corner must thaw before the palace can soften.
storyboardPanels: A royal corner glitters too cold.
Nixie warms one edge with her palm.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Perfect rooms cannot be laughed at.
No. But they cannot rest either.
This corner is not cold from command. It is cold from fear.

choices.label: Soften the Royal Edges
choices.playerLine: Edges first. Sharp things thaw unevenly.
choices.narration: Nixie softens the royal edges without melting the palace shape.

choices.label: Thaw the Hidden Corner
choices.playerLine: I will warm what you hid, not what you command.
choices.narration: The hidden corner thaws and reveals old festival ribbons. The palace remains standing, less afraid of curves.

choices.label: Crown the Crooked Snow
choices.playerLine: If he wants a crown, let it be snow that refuses to stay square.
choices.narration: Aurora frost curls over the palace. It is beautiful and deeply un-square.

postChoiceBarks.text: Thaw slowly. Truth cracks if rushed.

victoryCallback.text: The palace is still standing. It is simply less afraid of curves.

bossCallback.text: Bloxley, borrow a pillow. Brixonia has plenty.
